'''Clue scroll (beginner)''' is an [[anagram clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id =
|text = The anagram reveals<br>who to speak to:<br><br>SIR SHARE RED
|notes = Speak to the [[Hairdresser]] in [[Falador]].
|map = {{Map|x=2945|y=3380|mtype=pin}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Falador Teleport]].
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Sir Rebral]].
*[[Ring of wealth]] teleport to [[Falador Park]].
*[[Balloon transport system]] to [[Taverley]].
*[[Teleport to House]] with a [[player-owned house]] in Taverley, or [[Construction cape]] teleport to the Taverley [[house portal]].
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Mining Guild]].
*[[Ring of the elements]] teleport to the [[Air Altar]] and run north.
